name: skills
tagline_zh: 你的 Agent 只会聊天？给它装上 Hugging Face 全家桶——模型、数据集、推理，一句话调用。
tagline_en: Your agent just chats? Plug it into the HF ecosystem—models, datasets, inference, one command away.
desc_en: Give your agents the power of the Hugging Face ecosystem
why_zh: 同类工具只给接口，它直接打包整个 HF 生态，让 Agent 原生调用，省去自己拼装。
why_en: Others give APIs; this bundles the whole HF stack natively for agents—no glue code needed.
